subject: Private hosting technical deep dive — proposed windows
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Price <daniel.price@acmehealth.com>, Ops Engineering <ops@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jun 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Private hosting technical deep dive — proposed windows

Hi Daniel and team,

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier — appreciated the clear overview of Acme Health's priorities. Quick recap so we have the same page:
- Goal: Private/VPC-hosted Redwood instance for clinical triage assistant (PHI on-prem gateway + redwood managed control plane)
- Req'd controls: KMS integration (Cloud HSM preferred), audit logs retention (7 years), VPC peering w/ existing ops VPC, and IP allowlist for crawling endpoints
- Scale target: steady-state ~150–250 requests/s, peak bursts to ~600 RPS (short bursts)
- Timeline: pilot by Q4, production H2 rollout

Next step: schedule a 75–90 minute technical deep dive (infrastructure + security + ops) where our solutions engineer will walk the architecture options, runbook, and deployment checklist. Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Jul 3, 09:00–10:30
- Wed Jul 4, 13:00–14:30
- Thu Jul 5, 08:30–10:00

Please reply with the best option and any additional attendees we should include (security, networking, SRE). We also uploaded a short pre-call questionnaire and a very brief pre-read to the shared drive — links below. If you prefer, send a few slots and we’ll mirror them.

Pre-call asks (helps us prepare so we can make it productive):
- Primary AWS account ID(s) or VPC IDs we’ll reference
- Expected average and peak token throughput for the queries you’ll route to the private deployment
- Any regulatory constraints beyond SOC 2 (e.g., local data residency)

Attachments: redwood-mop-map.pdf (high level), privdeploy-precall-checklist.xlsx
Drive pre-read: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodPreRead
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/7654321

Look forward to locking a time — Laura (cc’d) will run the deep technical portion.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mateo: +1 (415) 555-0132

Thanks Mateo — good summary. Samira (ops lead) will join from our side.

We can do Wed Jul 4, 13:00–14:30 PT. If possible, push the meeting a few minutes later (13:15) so we can wrap a preceding call.

I attached the quick answers we captured on the pre-call questionnaire (acme-answers-20280621.pdf). AWS account ID is 987654321012. No extra residency constraints beyond SOC 2.

See you then — Daniel

daniel.price@acmehealth.com

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Ops Engineering <ops@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jun 2028 08:12:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Private hosting technical deep dive — proposed windows

Great — Wed Jul 4 at 13:15 PT is locked. I’ll send a calendar invite in a moment.

Agenda (75–90 min):
1) 5–10m quick context and success criteria (Mateo)
2) 30–40m architecture options (Laura) — VPC layout, routing, KMS integration, audit log pipeline
3) 20m ops/runbook and autoscaling behavior (Ben)
4) 15–20m Q&A and next steps (all)

Pre-call checklist (please confirm by EOD Mon Jul 2):
- AWS account ID: 987654321012 (received)
- VPC/subnet IDs (if you want us to reference specific routing tables)
- Any IP ranges you’ll require us to whitelabel
- Sample RPS and avg token sizes (helps estimate KV cache sizing)

I’ve attached the pre-call checklist and uploaded a 3-slide architecture primer to the Drive. Also adding the calendar link and a quick HubSpot reference.

Attachments: privdeploy-precall-checklist.xlsx, redwood-mop-map.pdf
Calendar: (invite sent)
Drive pre-read: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodPreRead
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/7654321

If Samira or your security lead has specific compliance artifacts they want reviewed ahead of time (e.g., encryption architecture), point them to the Drive and we’ll pull our SOC 2 checklist into the call.

Thanks — Laura will lead the technical segment.

Best,
Mateo
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Price <daniel.price@acmehealth.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private hosting technical deep dive — proposed windows

Hi Daniel / Samira — looking forward to the session. A couple quick notes from the technical side so we can hit the ground running: 

Pre-call items we’ll use in the prep (if you can drop them into the Drive):
- VPC ID(s) and core subnet CIDRs
- Traffic egress requirements and firewall rules you anticipate
- A short sample trace (1–2 anonymized requests) showing avg token count and latency requirements

Core topics we’ll cover in the deep dive:
- VPC architecture patterns (direct VPC peering vs. transit gateways)
- KMS/HSM integration options and key rotation practices
- KV cache sizing and warm-start strategies for burst tolerance
- Autoscaling behaviors, pre-warming, and graceful degradation policies
- Audit logs export, retention options, and how they map to your retention policy

If your security manager (cc’d if appropriate) can share a point that we should address up front, we’ll add it to the agenda. Otherwise, expect a technical runbook we can iterate on during the call.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
